title: The isFleetCapacityDecline comment promised an offer in the next pass without the batch qualifier of contract section 5
resolution: Reworded: the task keeps its wait, so the next pass that reads it offers it in its place in the rotation.

title: The placeDue comment said a declined task keeps waiting unchanged, clashing with the kept-wait term of the spec
resolution: Reworded: the transaction rolls back, and the task still waits.

title: No test checked that a fleet capacity decline keeps the failure count of an own-reason backoff
resolution: Added a unit test that fails if the decline forgets the wait or counts a failure; both mutations checked.

title: The fleet reasons comment ignored that worker-capacity-exhausted depends on the task's own request
resolution: The comment says the set is exact while all requests are equal; the design risks say per-task requests must revisit it.

title: The record cited the living execution-placement spec as changed although the branch changes only the delta
resolution: The self-check cites the delta and notes that the living requirement changes at archive.
